name: camayoc_ex_active_directives
description: Directives in force: every aegis:Directive nothing has superseded. A superseded directive is never deleted; this is the read-time join that says which one won.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?directive ?label WHERE { ?directive a aegis:Directive ; rdfs:label ?label . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?directive aegis:supersededBy ?newer } } ORDER BY ?label
